groups.about: cspaper.retrieval_method lists every retrieval method a paper names (35 of 199 papers name two or more); G1a counts a paper under each method it names (needs the list as stated), G1b counts each paper once, a combination of methods as hybrid retrieval (needs one value per paper)

G1a.question: For single-hop and multi-hop papers, how many use dense retrieval, sparse retrieval, graph-based retrieval, hybrid retrieval and web search? A paper counts under every method it names.
G1a.natural: SELECT reasoning_depth, COUNT(*) AS papers, SUM(CASE WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Dense%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dense, SUM(CASE WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Sparse%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sparse, SUM(CASE WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Graph%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS graph_based, SUM(CASE WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Hybrid%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hybrid, SUM(CASE WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Web%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS web_search FROM cspaper WHERE reasoning_depth IN ('multi-hop', 'single-hop') GROUP BY reasoning_depth;
G1a.key: SELECT reasoning_depth, COUNT(*) AS papers, SUM(CASE WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Dense%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dense, SUM(CASE WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Sparse%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sparse, SUM(CASE WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Graph%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS graph_based, SUM(CASE WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Hybrid%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hybrid, SUM(CASE WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%Web%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS web_search FROM cspaper WHERE reasoning_depth IN ('multi-hop', 'single-hop') GROUP BY reasoning_depth;

G1b.question: For each retrieval method, how many papers use it, how many of them use a reranker, and how many baselines do they compare against on average? A paper that combines two or more methods counts as hybrid retrieval.
G1b.natural: SELECT retrieval_method, COUNT(*) AS papers, SUM(CASE WHEN uses_reranker = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_reranker, AVG(baseline_amount) AS average_baselines FROM cspaper WHERE retrieval_method <> '' GROUP BY retrieval_method;
G1b.key: SELECT CASE WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%||%' THEN 'Hybrid Retrieval' ELSE retrieval_method END AS retrieval_method, COUNT(*) AS papers, SUM(CASE WHEN uses_reranker = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_reranker, AVG(baseline_amount) AS average_baselines FROM cspaper WHERE retrieval_method <> '' GROUP BY CASE WHEN retrieval_method LIKE '%||%' THEN 'Hybrid Retrieval' ELSE retrieval_method END;

groups.about: cspaper.application_domain lists every domain a paper targets (39 of 199 papers name two or more, often General plus a specific domain); G2a counts a paper under each domain it names (needs the list as stated), G2b counts each paper once under its specific domain (needs one value per paper)

G2a.question: For papers with and without an agent, how many are general-purpose and how many target medicine, education, finance and academic research? A paper counts under every domain it names.
G2a.natural: SELECT use_agent, COUNT(*) AS papers, SUM(CASE WHEN application_domain LIKE '%General%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS general_purpose, SUM(CASE WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Medical%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medical, SUM(CASE WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Education%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS education, SUM(CASE WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Finance%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finance, SUM(CASE WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Academic%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS academic FROM cspaper WHERE application_domain <> '' GROUP BY use_agent;
G2a.key: SELECT use_agent, COUNT(*) AS papers, SUM(CASE WHEN application_domain LIKE '%General%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS general_purpose, SUM(CASE WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Medical%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medical, SUM(CASE WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Education%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS education, SUM(CASE WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Finance%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finance, SUM(CASE WHEN application_domain LIKE '%Academic%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS academic FROM cspaper WHERE application_domain <> '' GROUP BY use_agent;

G2b.question: Counting each paper once under its specific application domain (General only if it names no other domain, Multiple if it names two or more specific ones), how many papers are there per domain, how many study multi-hop reasoning, and how many use a knowledge graph?
G2b.natural: SELECT application_domain, COUNT(*) AS papers, SUM(CASE WHEN reasoning_depth = 'multi-hop' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_hop, SUM(CASE WHEN uses_knowledge_graph = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_knowledge_graph FROM cspaper WHERE application_domain <> '' GROUP BY application_domain;
G2b.key: SELECT CASE WHEN application_domain NOT LIKE '%||%' THEN application_domain WHEN length(application_domain) - length(replace(application_domain, '||', '')) = 2 AND application_domain LIKE '%General%' THEN trim(replace(replace(application_domain, 'General||', ''), '|| General', '')) ELSE 'Multiple' END AS application_domain, COUNT(*) AS papers, SUM(CASE WHEN reasoning_depth = 'multi-hop' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_hop, SUM(CASE WHEN uses_knowledge_graph = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_knowledge_graph FROM cspaper WHERE application_domain <> '' GROUP BY CASE WHEN application_domain NOT LIKE '%||%' THEN application_domain WHEN length(application_domain) - length(replace(application_domain, '||', '')) = 2 AND application_domain LIKE '%General%' THEN trim(replace(replace(application_domain, 'General||', ''), '|| General', '')) ELSE 'Multiple' END;

groups.about: cspaper.performance_on_hotpotqa is the HotpotQA result as the paper states it (31 papers; metric names, model variants, several numbers); G3a needs each paper's best answer F1 as one number on a 0-100 scale (empty when the paper reports no answer F1), G3b needs the stated text to see which metrics are reported

G3a.question: For papers with and without an agent, what are the lowest and the highest answer F1 reported on HotpotQA, taking each paper's best F1 on a 0-100 scale?
G3a.natural: SELECT use_agent, MIN(performance_on_hotpotqa) AS lowest_hotpotqa_f1, MAX(performance_on_hotpotqa) AS best_hotpotqa_f1 FROM cspaper WHERE performance_on_hotpotqa <> '' GROUP BY use_agent;
G3a.key: SELECT use_agent, MIN(f1) AS lowest_hotpotqa_f1, MAX(f1) AS best_hotpotqa_f1 FROM (SELECT use_agent, CASE paper_name WHEN 'learning to Refine Query for Retrieval Augmented Generation (RQ-RAG)' THEN 62.6 WHEN 'A Multi-Source Retrieval Question Answering Framework Based on RAG' THEN 30.66 WHEN 'DR-RAG: Applying Dynamic Document Relevance to RetrievalAugmented Generation for Question-Answering' THEN 62.87 WHEN 'Enhancing Retrieval and Managing Retrieval: A Four-Module Synergy for Improved Quality and Efficiency in RAG Systems' THEN 57.59 WHEN 'SMART-RAG: Selection using Determinantal Matrices for Augmented Retrieval' THEN 40.8 WHEN 'OPEN-RAG: Enhanced Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning with Open-Source Large Language Models' THEN 76.9 WHEN 'DMQR-RAG: DIVERSE MULTI-QUERY REWRITING FOR RETRIEVAL-AUGMENTED GENERATION' THEN 53.99 WHEN 'MBA-RAG: a Bandit Approach for Adaptive Retrieval-Augmented Generation through Question Complexity' THEN 53.3 WHEN 'Post-training an LLM for RAG? Train on Self-Generated Demonstrations' THEN 75.9 WHEN 'Vendi-RAG: Adaptively Trading-Off Diversity And Quality Significantly Improves Retrieval Augmented Generation With LLMs' THEN 57.0 WHEN 'Unveiling Knowledge Utilization Mechanisms in LLM-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation' THEN 59.57 WHEN 'KARE-RAG: Knowledge-Aware Refinement and Enhancement for RAG' THEN 46.45 WHEN 'BEE-RAG: Balanced Entropy Engineering for Retrieval-Augmented Generation' THEN 44.81 WHEN 'Transforming Questions and Documents for Semantically Aligned Retrieval-Augmented Generation' THEN 67.5 WHEN 'CORE: LOSSLESS COMPRESSION FOR RETRIEVALAUGMENTED LLMS VIA REINFORCEMENT LEARNING' THEN 46.35 WHEN 'TeaRAG: A Token-Efficient Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework' THEN 63.14 WHEN 'Answering-Students-Questions-on-Course-Forums-Using-Multiple-Chain-of-Thought-Reasoning-and-Finetuni' THEN 62.2 END AS f1 FROM cspaper) WHERE f1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY use_agent;

G3b.question: For papers with and without a reranker that report HotpotQA results, how many report an F1 score and how many report accuracy?
G3b.natural: SELECT uses_reranker, COUNT(*) AS papers, SUM(CASE WHEN performance_on_hotpotqa LIKE '%F1%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS report_f1, SUM(CASE WHEN performance_on_hotpotqa LIKE '%Acc%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS report_accuracy FROM cspaper WHERE performance_on_hotpotqa <> '' AND uses_reranker IN ('Yes', 'No') GROUP BY uses_reranker;
G3b.key: SELECT uses_reranker, COUNT(*) AS papers, SUM(CASE WHEN performance_on_hotpotqa LIKE '%F1%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS report_f1, SUM(CASE WHEN performance_on_hotpotqa LIKE '%Acc%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS report_accuracy FROM cspaper WHERE performance_on_hotpotqa <> '' AND uses_reranker IN ('Yes', 'No') GROUP BY uses_reranker;

groups.about: cspaper.data_modality lists the input types a paper handles (Text, Image, Table, Code, Audio; 53 papers name more than text alone); G4a counts papers per stated input type (needs the list as stated), G4b compares text-only with multimodal papers (needs one coarse value per paper)

G4a.question: For single-hop and multi-hop papers, how many handle images, tables, code and audio as input?
G4a.natural: SELECT reasoning_depth, COUNT(*) AS papers, SUM(CASE WHEN data_modality LIKE '%Image%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS image, SUM(CASE WHEN data_modality LIKE '%Table%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tables, SUM(CASE WHEN data_modality LIKE '%Code%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS code, SUM(CASE WHEN data_modality LIKE '%Audio%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS audio FROM cspaper WHERE reasoning_depth IN ('multi-hop', 'single-hop') GROUP BY reasoning_depth;
G4a.key: SELECT reasoning_depth, COUNT(*) AS papers, SUM(CASE WHEN data_modality LIKE '%Image%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS image, SUM(CASE WHEN data_modality LIKE '%Table%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tables, SUM(CASE WHEN data_modality LIKE '%Code%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS code, SUM(CASE WHEN data_modality LIKE '%Audio%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS audio FROM cspaper WHERE reasoning_depth IN ('multi-hop', 'single-hop') GROUP BY reasoning_depth;

G4b.question: How do text-only papers compare with multimodal papers (any image, table, code or audio input): how many are there, how many use an agent, and how many use a reranker?
G4b.natural: SELECT data_modality, COUNT(*) AS papers, SUM(CASE WHEN use_agent = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_agent, SUM(CASE WHEN uses_reranker = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_reranker FROM cspaper WHERE data_modality IN ('Text', 'Multimodal') GROUP BY data_modality;
G4b.key: SELECT CASE WHEN data_modality = 'Text' THEN 'Text' ELSE 'Multimodal' END AS data_modality, COUNT(*) AS papers, SUM(CASE WHEN use_agent = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_agent, SUM(CASE WHEN uses_reranker = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_reranker FROM cspaper WHERE data_modality <> '' AND data_modality <> 'proprietary enterprise dataset' GROUP BY CASE WHEN data_modality = 'Text' THEN 'Text' ELSE 'Multimodal' END;

groups.about: cspaper.generator_model lists the generator models as each paper spells them (Llama2-7B, Llama 2 7B, LLaMA-2-7b, Qwen-2.5-7B, GPT-4o, ...); G5a needs model versions under one spelling (Llama 2, Llama 3, Qwen2.5), G5b needs one coarse class per paper (proprietary only, open-weight only, both)

G5a.question: For single-hop and multi-hop papers, how many papers are there, and how many use a Llama 2 model, a Llama 3 model (any 3.x release) and a Qwen2.5 model as a generator?
G5a.natural: SELECT reasoning_depth, COUNT(*) AS papers, SUM(CASE WHEN generator_model LIKE '%Llama 2%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS llama_2, SUM(CASE WHEN generator_model LIKE '%Llama 3%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS llama_3, SUM(CASE WHEN generator_model LIKE '%Qwen2.5%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS qwen_2_5 FROM cspaper WHERE reasoning_depth IN ('multi-hop', 'single-hop') GROUP BY reasoning_depth;
G5a.key: SELECT reasoning_depth, COUNT(*) AS papers, SUM(CASE WHEN (replace(replace(replace(lower(generator_model), ' ', ''), '-', ''), 'shearedllama2.7b', '') LIKE '%llama2%' OR replace(replace(lower(generator_model), ' ', ''), '-', '') LIKE '%llama7bchat%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS llama_2, SUM(CASE WHEN (replace(replace(lower(generator_model), ' ', ''), '-', '') LIKE '%llama3%' OR replace(replace(lower(generator_model), ' ', ''), '-', '') LIKE '%llama8binstruct%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS llama_3, SUM(CASE WHEN replace(replace(lower(generator_model), ' ', ''), '-', '') LIKE '%qwen2.5%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS qwen_2_5 FROM cspaper WHERE reasoning_depth IN ('multi-hop', 'single-hop') GROUP BY reasoning_depth;
